post.description:
Athlete self-registration. Creates an OPEN_ATHLETE; sign in with /auth/login.
Rate limited per client IP (429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After).
Rotate the refresh token and re-derive role and tenant.

Revoke the current session. WEB and STOREFRONT: only that client's cookie is read and
cleared; the other website's session in the same browser is untouched.

Change the password; clears ``must_change_password`` and signs out the user's other
sessions (their refresh tokens are revoked; the calling session stays). Allowed while a change
is required.

get.description: Profile of the caller. Allowed while ``must_change_password`` is true.
White-label configuration of the caller's gym (tenant from the token). 404 without a gym.
Movement catalog ordered by key, with ``pr_family`` (D-029, D-038).

patch.description: Rename, change ``pr_family`` or (de)activate. The key is immutable.

get.description: PR catalog (sections STRENGTH and WEIGHTLIFTING), ordered by key (D-047).
Gym programs of the caller's tenant: CLASS, ADVANCED and CUSTOM plans.

post.description: Create the CUSTOM plan of one athlete of the gym (one per athlete). MARKETPLACE from M6.

patch.description: Name and description. The ADVANCED audience is set from M3.

get.description: Workouts of a date range (inclusive, at most 21 days), drafts included (D-064).

put.description:
Create or replace the workout of a day as DRAFT or PUBLISHED and return the canonical
document. Validated against the workout schema and its extra rules (422
``WORKOUT_SCHEMA_INVALID``). Increments ``revision`` when it was already published; a
published workout cannot go back to DRAFT (400). Never sends notifications.

post.description:
Publish every draft of the Sunday-to-Saturday week that starts on ``week_start`` (D-066).
``notify_athletes`` requests one push; push is sent from M5.

get.description:
Published workouts of one date for every program the caller can see. Past dates are
read-only history; a date after the Saturday of the caller's current week (Sunday to
Saturday, profile time zone) is rejected with 400 ``WEEK_NOT_VISIBLE`` (D-064).

Same as the feed for at most 7 days, never after the Saturday of the current week (400
``WEEK_NOT_VISIBLE``); used to fill the offline cache with the current week.

post.description:
Publish a draft; already published workouts are returned unchanged. ``notify_athletes``
requests the programming push, sent from M5 (D-066).

Copy a day into another date or program of the gym as a DRAFT (D-059). 409
``WORKOUT_DATE_TAKEN`` when the target day already has a workout.

delete.description: Soft delete; athletes' logs are kept (D-043).

post.description:
Provision a gym: tenant, owner, box code, CLASS and ADVANCED programs and advanced group.
The owner's temporary password is returned **only once**.

Generate a new temporary password (returned once). The user must change it at the next
sign-in and every open session is revoked. Replaces email reset until M8.

ClientType.title: ClientType
ClientType.description: WEB is the web admin, STOREFRONT the Marketplace website (Q-045, D-069).

anyOf.description: Generic code for any other 4xx status, for example HTTP_406.

has_session_flow.title: Has Session Flow
has_session_flow.description: Checkboxes and Finish workout (false for CLASS).

MovementUpdate.title: MovementUpdate
MovementUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed; ``pr_family: null`` clears it. The key is immutable.

assigned_coach_id.title: Assigned Coach Id
assigned_coach_id.description: An owner or coach of the gym; defaults to the caller (D-067).

ProgramCreate.title: ProgramCreate
ProgramCreate.description:
M2 creates CUSTOM plans only; MARKETPLACE programs arrive in M6. CLASS and ADVANCED exist
from tenant provisioning.

assigned_coach_id.title: Assigned Coach Id
assigned_coach_id.description: CUSTOM only: the staff member in charge of the plan (D-067).

ProgramUpdate.title: ProgramUpdate
ProgramUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent are changed; ``description: null`` clears it. ``assigned_coach_id``
(CUSTOM only, never null) can be changed by the owner or the current assigned coach.

PublishRequest.title: PublishRequest
PublishRequest.description: ``notify_athletes`` requests the programming push; it is sent from M5 (D-066).

week_start.title: Week Start
week_start.description: Sunday that starts the week (Sunday to Saturday).

RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest
RefreshRequest.description:
MOBILE sends ``refresh_token`` in the body; WEB and STOREFRONT send only ``client`` and
their own cookie.

privacy_consent.title: Privacy Consent
privacy_consent.description: Must be true: explicit privacy consent.

TenantConfig.title: TenantConfig
TenantConfig.description: White-label configuration of the caller's tenant (GET /tenants/me/config).

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Only for MOBILE clients. WEB clients receive it in the httpOnly cookie `ohmycoach_refresh`, STOREFRONT clients in `ohmycoach_market_refresh`, and the field is absent.

WorkoutDocument.title: Workout
WorkoutDocument.description: One training day of a program as an ordered list of blocks. A block is one numbered section of the coach's programming and contains one or more parts. Single source of truth for backend, web admin and mobile. See docs/shared/04-workout-block-model.md.

WorkoutUpsert.title: WorkoutUpsert
WorkoutUpsert.description:
``workout_id``, ``program_id``, ``date`` and ``status`` inside the document are overwritten
by the server (the path, the stored id and ``status`` of this body) before validation.
